title: Investigation of Clinical Feature and Brain Function in Narcoleptic Patients
brief_summary: This study evaluates the PSG and cerebral metabolism and functions in narcolepsy with/without RBD
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Narcolepsy meet to the international classification of sleep disorder,3rd edition (ICSD-3) , and RBD meet to the minimal diagnostic criteria according to the international Classification of Sleep, control subjects .

Exclusion Criteria:

History of heart disease History of central nervous system organic psychosis AHI\>15次/h History of alcohol dependence and drug abuse
study_population: The study will need about 40 narcoleptic patients with /without RBD between 10 and 65 years of age,and about 20 age- and gender-matched control subjects.
